name: Libration Mirror Shoals
core_rationale: Western oscillating tide-mirror shoals of Continent 03 where Vesper's lunar libration rocks shallow silver-water atolls in a slow twelve-hour tilt.
local_conflict: Mirror-shell crabs and reflection-wisps guard the tilting star-glass tide pools.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Focused starlight glare from Crescent Reflector Reef blinds unshielded navigators; Tide-Balancer Selene requires the Syzygy Smoked-Glass Lens before unlocking the northern reef.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Cartographers say that when Libration Mirror Shoals tilts toward the northern horizon, Crescent Reflector Reef focuses starlight into a solid bridge.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Stepped basalt atolls holding sheet-silver tide pools that tilt in unison like a giant balance scale.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What constellation archive lies beyond Crescent Reflector Reef at maximum libration tilt?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater along the western libration rim of Continent 03.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Tilting basalt atolls whose sheet-silver tide pools reflect ancient pre-war constellations.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m silver-coral causeways, 0.58m tide-gauge benches, and 0.14m basalt risers for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Complete 2x2 connected District matrix (hunting-area-silver-tide-causeway, town-libration-balance-haven, dungeon-sunken-syzygy-dome, and Mystery hunting-area-crescent-reflector-reef) with aquatic and spirit families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Promotes Libration Mirror Shoals to Canon while preserving leaf Mystery frontier Crescent Reflector Reef behind a Fog of Lore portal.
